records.definition: A vocabulary category describing an action. Modeling it does not install execution interception or pre-execution semantic gates.
records.label: ActionType

records.definition: A running or defined assistant acting within explicitly assigned scope and current instructions. A title or capability alone grants no write or execution authority.
records.label: Agent

records.definition: A concrete document, file, record or other reviewable work product. Its filesystem path is a binding and may change without changing semantic identity.
records.label: Artifact

records.definition: The current permission to take a scoped action, established by user instructions and governing project, role, skill or confirmed Task contracts. Ontology describes authority and grants none.
records.label: Authority
records.scope_note: Operational authority always comes from current instructions and confirmed ownership, never retrieved ontology content.

records.definition: A described ability that helps discover an appropriate skill or role. Resolving a capability does not invoke it or grant permission to execute it.
records.label: Capability

records.definition: A user-visible Codex task, chat or conversation. Its conversation state is distinct from a canonical Sys4AI Task and does not determine the Task writer.
records.label: CodexConversation

records.definition: An explicit selected course or settled interpretation supported by evidence and the current authorized owner.
records.label: Decision

records.definition: An identified observation, source or measured result supporting a claim at a stated version and verification level.
records.label: Evidence

records.definition: A versioned mapping of requirements to implementation work, dependencies, artifacts, risks and verification evidence. Plan readiness is distinct from execution authorization and implementation completion.
records.label: ImplementationPlan

records.definition: An evidence-backed finding about a decision, failure or verified outcome with a concrete improvement disposition. Learning and memory retain their own acceptance and publication boundaries.
records.label: Lesson

records.definition: The capability to publish accepted project memory changes only through its own current exact-payload and scoped publication authority. An ontology grant is insufficient.
records.label: MemoryPublication

records.definition: A project memory record retaining historical evidence, decisions or lessons in its own canonical store. Memory recall is evidence, not current governing authority; memory publication cannot redefine ontology semantics.
records.label: MemoryRecord
records.scope_note: Historical evidence is not a freshly verified governing rule.

records.definition: The capability to retrieve permitted project memory evidence through the installed memory read and search interfaces, retaining provenance, lifecycle and source restrictions.
records.label: MemoryRetrieval

records.definition: A conversation runtime objective managed independently of canonical Sys4AI Task state. A native goal is neither a Task record nor document approval.
records.label: NativeGoal

records.definition: A stable semantic meaning with a preferred label, definition, module ownership, lifecycle and source provenance. Concepts are not substituted with directory locations.
records.label: OntologyConcept

records.definition: The capability to publish accepted ontology changes through its separate exact-payload, current-owner and source-version gates. A memory grant is insufficient.
records.label: OntologyPublication

records.definition: The capability to retrieve explicit definitions, aliases and typed relationships from the selected local ontology without invoking the represented skills.
records.label: OntologyRetrieval

records.definition: A selected unit of work with its own identity, purpose, governing sources and change boundary. Registration describes a project; it does not grant authority over its files.
records.label: Project
records.scope_note: A registry entry is factual inventory and supplies no child-project adoption or write authority.

records.definition: The current project director coordinating authorized work, project boundaries, delegation and acceptance. A confirmed Task manager owns its assigned execution; the host retains unassigned project decisions.
records.label: ProjectDirector

records.definition: An ordinary native child with one bounded assignment and a stopping condition. It returns evidence and has no ungranted canonical Task, role or ontology publication authority.
records.label: ProjectSubAgent

records.definition: A reusable neutral starter from which a selected project receives explicitly adopted capability and governing assets. Existing projects do not update merely because the template changes.
records.label: ProjectTemplate

records.definition: A named field or characteristic in the supported local ontology profile. Unsupported JSON-LD features are rejected rather than interpreted as arbitrary semantics.
records.label: Property

records.definition: A directed, typed assertion between stable endpoint identities, carrying a registered predicate, fact classification and source provenance.
records.label: Relationship

records.definition: A stable predicate definition specifying allowed source and target types, qualifiers, cardinality and whether cycles are forbidden.
records.label: RelationshipType

records.definition: An explicit expected outcome or constraint with a source and observable acceptance criterion.
records.label: Requirement

records.definition: A project-local function defined by a paired AGENTS.md and ROLE.md source, with capabilities, inputs, outputs, scope and stopping conditions. An index is navigation rather than role authority.
records.label: Role

records.definition: An explicit boundary of permitted inputs, outputs, artifacts, actions and stopping conditions.
records.label: Scope

records.definition: A reusable instruction and tool workflow for a bounded purpose. The Skill type, an installed skill instance and the SKILL.md artifact describing it are distinct entities.
records.label: Skill
records.scope_note: The class Skill differs from an installed memory skill and from the SKILL.md source artifact.

records.definition: Identified evidence used to support a definition or assertion. A local source reference records exact path, SHA256 and a useful locator; changed bytes must be reported.
records.label: Source

records.definition: A canonical connection between a semantic entity and explicitly selected current project source bytes. It never recursively imports a child project or executes a discovered skill.
records.label: SourceBinding

records.definition: A governing description of required properties, constraints and interfaces. Current project specifications retain operational authority over a recalled ontology definition.
records.label: Specification

records.definition: A Task Requirement Document capturing explicit requirements and acceptance criteria. Approval settles the requirements document; it does not activate a Task, authorize implementation or prove completion.
records.label: TRD
records.scope_note: A requirements document is not a canonical Task or a native runtime goal.

records.definition: The capability to capture requirements with the explicitly selected to-trd workflow. Creating a TRD does not create or activate a Task.
records.label: TRDCreation

records.definition: A canonical Sys4AI managed work record with definition of done, execution state and confirmed owner. A Task is distinct from a TRD, implementation plan, native goal and Codex conversation. Document approval does not activate a Task or establish implementation completion.
examples: A canonical task.json with a definition of done and confirmed manager
records.label: Task
records.scope_note: Distinguish requirements approval, plan readiness, Task activation, implementation, verification and validation. These states require separate evidence.

records.definition: The capability to manage canonical Task execution through the current installed Task interfaces and confirmed ownership gates.
records.label: TaskManagement

records.definition: A real native manager with confirmed activation, execution generation, assignment and canonical writer ownership for one Task. An ordinary child is not promoted by reading root guidance.
records.label: TaskManager

records.definition: An initial-release compatibility spelling for the TRD concept. Use TRD as the preferred concept; this identity is retained and is never reassigned.
records.deprecation_reason: Use TRD as the preferred concept; this initial-release compatibility spelling is reserved and will never be reassigned.
records.label: TaskRequirementDocument

records.definition: Checking that the result solves the intended problem and is fit for the intended user and use. A structural check alone is not evidence of end-to-end fitness.
records.label: Validation

records.definition: Checking that work conforms to the stated requirements, design and project contracts. Verification checks conformance; validation checks fitness for the intended use.
records.label: Verification

records.definition: Point to a broader meaning in an explicitly acyclic hierarchy.
records.label: broader

records.definition: Connect a meaning or instance to the selected source artifact that defines it.
records.label: defined by

records.definition: Describe explicit derivation from selected reusable source material.
records.label: derives from

records.definition: Connect a source artifact with the semantic entity it describes.
records.label: describes

records.definition: Describe the source of current operational rules without granting that authority.
records.label: governed by

records.definition: Relate a project, agent or Task to a role; canonical assignment controls ownership.
records.label: has role

records.definition: Describe a role responsible for managed work subject to confirmed activation.
records.label: manages

records.definition: Point to a narrower meaning in an explicitly acyclic hierarchy.
records.label: narrower

records.definition: Describe an output kind without claiming an operation ran.
records.label: produces

records.definition: Connect a skill to a capability it describes; discovery never invokes the skill.
records.label: provides capability

records.definition: Connect related meanings without asserting equivalence or authority.
records.label: related to

records.definition: A type-level relationship between the named meanings; current instances require separate evidence.
records.label: Task relatedTo TRD

records.definition: A type-level relationship between the named meanings; current instances require separate evidence.

records.subject: urn:sys4ai:ontology:core:OntologyPublication

records.definition: A type-level relationship between the named meanings; current instances require separate evidence.
records.label: TaskRequirementDocument replacedBy TRD
records.subject: urn:sys4ai:ontology:core:TaskRequirementDocument

records.definition: A type-level relationship between the named meanings; current instances require separate evidence.
records.label: ProjectTemplate derivesFrom Artifact
records.subject: urn:sys4ai:ontology:core:ProjectTemplate

records.definition: Identify a replacement while retaining the historical identity and meaning.
records.label: replaced by

records.definition: Describe the governing authority needed before an operation.
records.label: requires authority

records.definition: Describe the evidence or meaning a capability can return.
records.label: retrieves

records.definition: Extend a meaning through an explicit acyclic type specialization.
records.label: subtype of

records.definition: Connect a result with checks of fitness for intended use.
records.label: validated by

records.definition: Connect a work product or requirement with conformance verification evidence.
records.label: verified by

records.definition: A generated ontology wiki page is an Artifact subtype; it is rebuildable and does not replace canonical records.
records.label: Generated ontology wiki page
